name: Synaply
description: Connect Claude to your organization's permission-aware knowledge. Synaply searches across connected email, chat, files, code, calendars, CRM records, insights, and people; reads verified source documents; traces decisions and outcomes; and lets users share durable insights for org-wide learning. Results are limited to the authenticated user's workspace permissions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Synaply to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Synaply to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.synaply.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Synaply MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Synaply provides these MCP tools: share_insight, synaply_get_outcome, synaply_list_entities, synaply_read_document_full, synaply_read_documents, and synaply_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Synaply?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Synaply in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Synaply requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Synaply is developed by Synaply. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
